chineseName: 根据飞书任务号跳转详情页
name: feishu-issue-jump
content:
javascript:(function(){const n={f:"issue/detail",g:"assignment/detail",m:"story/detail",s:"s/detail"},t="https://project.feishu.cn/b2rl2h";function r(n){if(!n)return null;const t=n.trim().toLowerCase().match(/^([fgms])-(\d+)$/);if(t){const[,n,r]=t;return{prefix:n,number:r}}return null}function i(r,i){const e=`${t}/${n[r]}/${i}`;window.open(e,"_blank")}function e(){for(;;){const n=window.prompt("请输入飞书任务号
支持格式：f-123, g-456, m-789, s-012");if(!n)return;const t=r(n);if(t)return void i(t.prefix,t.number);window.alert("❌ 任务号格式错误！

正确格式示例：
• f-123
• g-456
• m-789
• s-012")}}async function o(){try{if(!navigator.clipboard||!navigator.clipboard.readText)return e();const n=r(await navigator.clipboard.readText());n?i(n.prefix,n.number):e()}catch(n){e()}}o();})();
